R3.title: «Գծագիր → Իրականություն» — animated renovation (blueprint room → finished room)
R3.honesty: NO photos at all after the intro. The room is drawn procedurally (SVG) inside the renderer: no stock, no AI images, no GARON project is shown or implied. It is a visualization of how a renovation comes together, step by step. Caption says so (03-copy.json R3).
R3.renderer: marketing/instagram/2026-11-12-reel-3-renovation/04-R3-renderer.js — usage: NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node 04-R3-renderer.js <repo_root> <out_dir> [all|cover|0,30,...] (writes R3_%03d.png, R3_cover.png, measure.json; f0–179 are delegated to tools/render_l02_frames.js). If code and spec disagree, the spec wins.
R3.encode: python3 marketing/instagram/tools/compose_l02_audio.py intro_r3.wav --intro-only && ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i R3_%03d.png -i intro_r3.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 18 -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -t 26 -movflags +faststart R3_reel.mp4 ; cover: python3 marketing/instagram/tools/png2jpg.py R3_cover.png R3_cover.jpg 92

timebase.note: intro 0–179 (= L02 v4, 3 bars); every stage change on a beat (multiples of 15 frames); f780 = bar 14.1 (clean loop)

z_order: scene window: [result SVG] + [plan SVG in a clip box (left of the divider)], both inside one camera wrapper

theme.note: = R2 v2 theme (paper #f5f5f3, dark gold #856727 for thin lines/small text on paper, light gold #c9a96a for the divider/handle ring and the gold piece). The room uses its own muted warm palette (room.palette).
theme.logo_note: garon-logo-light.svg = DARK logo for LIGHT backgrounds (fills #1e1e1e, gradients gmlight #a3a3a3→#4f4f4f and gglight #d4b57a→#b8955c). Path data and the <rect> are byte-identical to garon-logo-dark.svg, so every geometry number of v2 (clips, pieces, wordmark glyph bounds, box) is unchanged.

easings.note: CSS cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2) control points; evaluate exactly like CSS (solve x(t)=p by Newton/bisection, return y(t)).

R3.keyframes_rule: Every animated property is a list of keys [frame, value, easing]. Before the first key: first value; after the last key: last value. Between key k and k+1: v = v_k + (v_k+1 − v_k) · E((f − f_k)/(f_k+1 − f_k)), E = easing NAMED IN KEY k (see `easings`). "hold" = keep v_k until f_k+1 then jump. Vector values ([x,y] or {x,y,w,h}) interpolate component-wise.
R3.fonts_check: Armenian glyphs must come from Noto Serif Armenian / Noto Sans Armenian (check document.fonts / computed font in a test frame). STOP if a fallback system font is used.

window.note: = R2 window. All room geometry below is in WINDOW-LOCAL px (0,0 = window top-left, 940×1253).

vlines.note: v2: = L02 v4 keys (fade-in 176–196 starts inside the borrowed intro; continuous across f179→f180)

intro.source: IDENTICAL to L02 v4 frames 0–179: items.L02 of marketing/instagram/2026-11-11-launch/04-render-spec.json (stage, build, blueprint, ground_line, dimensions, glint, wordmark, vlines, theme, easings), rendered by marketing/instagram/tools/render_l02_frames.js. intro.what: L02 v4 logo build-up: blueprint grid, ground line draws from the centre (6–36), stems rise (45/50/55), roof bands slide (60–), gold piece lands with shake + impact glow at f105 (3.5 s), camera pull-back 120–148, glint 124–150 + wordmark tracks in, finished lockup = garon-logo-light.svg at 200,700 680×496 from f148; real logo from f167. No text, no grain, no corner logo, no labels in f0–179.

camera_exit.what: f180+: the finished lockup (logo 680×496 at 200,700, transform-origin 342.4px 158px) continues exactly as in L02: scale = exit_scale_mul, opacity = exit_opacity; hidden after f198

intro.replaced_v1: v1 outline → pour intro (f0–135, horizon shutter at f120) removed on owner feedback 2026-11-12 (L02 intro was better).

entry.note: = R2 v2 pair H entry: the gold piece of the finished L02 lockup grows into the window (g = 1.6·32^inOutCubic((f−180)/12)) and opens on the blueprint sheet; the lockup pushes in and fades under it (intro.camera_exit). The scene window div sits at (70,390): its clip polygon = (gold polygon ∩ window) − (70,390).

gold_piece.shape_note: the GOLD path of the logo relative to its anchor (330, 132.5) in mark units
gold_piece.g: px per unit: g = 1.6 for f ≤ e; g = 1.6·32^E((f−e)/12) for e < f ≤ e+12, E = inOutCubic (→ 51.2: the polygon covers the window from e+12)
gold_piece.formula: incoming shot layer clipped to (anchor + g·shape_unit) ∩ window

gold_fill.css: same clip polygon filled with linear-gradient(135deg,#d4b57a,#b8955c), layer above the shots
gold_fill.opacity: relative keys [[e−4,0,outSine],[e−1,1,hold],[e+3,1,outSine],[e+10,0]] — a small solid gold piece (141 px wide) appears in the window centre on the beat before e, then grows and opens into the next shot

room.projection: one-point perspective. World metres: x right, y up (floor 0), z depth from the camera. Screen (window-local px): sx = vp.x + f·(x − cam.x)/z ; sy = vp.y − f·(y − cam.y)/z.

camera.what: whole scene wrapper (result + plan together): translate(drift) scale(z), transform-origin = vp

palette.plaster_tile: 256 px soft value noise (seed 11), multiply, opacity 0.06

led.note: two recessed linear channels in depth + cove line along the top of the back wall

floor.laying: board appears (opacity 0→1 + 6 px drop, 8 frames, outCubic) at f = 332 + 44·(z_back − z_far)/(z_back − z_near) + 6·rand → row by row, back wall first

furniture.what: flat oat rug x −1.75..1.75, z 3.25..5.45, inner border 0.12 m

framed art on the back wall above the sofa x −0.7..0.7 y 1.3..2.15: charcoal frame, paper mat, gold arch + thin charcoal horizon
brass floor lamp x 1.85 z 5.0: base, pole to 1.55 m, linen shade, warm glow (radial, screen 0.55)

plan_lines.what: one line set used twice: (a) drawn-in on the result SVG during Նախագիծ, (b) static full-strength on the plan SVG for the slider. Draw-in = stroke-dasharray with pathLength 1, dashoffset 1 − E((f − s)/(e − s)), E = outCubic.

groups.what: 4 room edges from the back-wall corners to the window edges
window on the left wall (frame + mullion)
floor perspective lines every 0.8 m + 3 cross lines
LED channels (thin double lines) on the ceiling
dimension lines with 45° ticks: width «5 600» above the back wall, height «2 900» left of it (Montserrat 500 15 px #856727, opacity fades in 244–256)

plan_lines.result_opacity_note: the drawing stays under the finishes as faint architectural edges (lines are drawn ABOVE the fills)

walls.what: SVG mask, linear gradient wipe: back wall left→right, side walls from the back corner outwards, ceiling from the back wall to the front

dim_overlay.impl: applied ONLY to the finishes (walls, ceiling, floor) as an SVG feComponentTransfer: channel slope = 1 − o·(1 − dim_c/255) (= multiply by the dim colour at opacity o); paper, grid and lines stay clean

light.flash: LED channel pulse: glow opacity overshoots 1.25 at +4 frames, settles to 1 by +14

slider.p_note: p ∈ [0,1], divider x (window-local) = 940·p. LEFT of the divider = Գծագիր (plan SVG), right = Արդյունք. p = 0: finished room.

light_leaks.css: div 900x900, radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255,214,150,0.9), rgba(201,169,106,0.35) 45%, rgba(201,169,106,0) 100%), mix-blend-mode screen, centred (cx, cy)

grain.css: full-frame div, background = 256x256 grayscale noise tile (deterministic PRNG seed 7, values 128±40), mix-blend-mode overlay, opacity 0.05; background-position shifts every 2 frames by ((37·k) mod 256, (91·k) mod 256), k = floor(f/2)
grain.note: paper texture, invisible on a phone at arm's length but kills the 'flat digital' look; v2: OFF in f0–179 (the borrowed L02 intro has no grain, frames must stay identical), fades in 180–196 (keys `opacity`)

R3.alt_hy: Կարճ անիմացիա բաց ֆոնի վրա։ Ճարտարապետական ցանցի վրա կառուցվում է GARON նշանը, և նրա ոսկեգույն մասը բացում է գծագրի թերթը։ Բարակ մուգ գծերով գծվում է սենյակ՝ պատեր, պատուհան, դուռ, առաստաղ, չափային գծեր։ Հետո փուլ առ փուլ. պատերը ծեփվում են տաք սպիտակով, հատակին շարք առ շարք դրվում են կաղնու տախտակներ, վառվում են առաստաղի գծային լույսերը և պատուհանից ընկնում է արևի լույսը, հայտնվում են գորգ, բազմոց, սուրճի սեղան, ձիթենի, նկար և հատակի լամպ։ Ոսկեգույն սահիչը ցույց է տալիս գծագիրը և պատրաստի սենյակը կողք կողքի։ Վերջին կադրում՝ լոգոն, «Լողավազաններ · Տներ · Վերանորոգում» և garon.am։
